card.name: Words just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The word 'greater' (or 'of', 'from', 'dose') right before a number with a unit, as in 'dose of greater than 120 mg'. It fires in dosing statements and duration phrases that lead into a numeric amount.

modes.label: Greater than a dose
modes.description: The word 'greater' after 'dose of' or in parentheses, leading into a numeric dose limit.

modes.label: Of or from before a number
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'from' directly before a dose amount or time span.
modes.example: Administer a dexamethasone dose<< of>> 20 mg on Day 1
